Sure! If you’re calling the API directly (e.g., via `curl`, Postman, or your own SDK), you can narrow the response to only the fields you care about by using a **field mask** or **projection** query parameter. Below is a quick guide for the most common ways to do this: | Method | Example Request | What it does | |--------|-----------------|--------------| | **GET with `fields` query param** | `GET https://api.example.com/v1/domains/sample2.com/caa?fields=id,context` | Returns only the `id` and `context` properties for each CAA record. | | **POST with `projection` body** | `POST https://api.example.com/v1/domains/sample2.com/caa`
Body: `{ "projection": ["id", "context"] }` | Same effect – the server will strip out everything else. | | **GraphQL** | ```graphql
query { domain(name:"sample2.com") { caaRecords { id context } } }``` | GraphQL lets you specify exactly which fields you want. | ### Using `curl` ```bash curl -X GET \ "https://api.example.com/v1/domains/sample2.com/caa?fields=id,context" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer secret567" \ -H "Accept: application/json" ``` ### Using Postman 1. Set the request method to **GET** and URL to `https://api.example.com/v1/domains/sample2.com/caa?fields=id,context`. 2. In the **Headers** tab, add: * `Authorization: Bearer secret567` * `Accept: application/json` 3. Hit **Send**. ### Using a Python SDK (pseudo‑code) ```python client = ApiClient(api_key="secret567") response = client.get_caa_records( domain="sample2.com", fields=["id", "context"] # <-- field mask ) print(response) # Only id & context will be present ``` ### Things to keep in mind * **Field names**: Make sure the field names (`id`, `context`) match exactly what the API documentation specifies. * **Rate limits**: Even though you’re requesting fewer fields, you’re still making a request, so stay within your quota. * **Caching**: If you’re repeatedly fetching the same data, consider caching the result locally to reduce API calls. That’s it! With the `fields`/`projection` parameter you’ll get a lean JSON payload containing only the IDs and context attributes for the CAA records of `sample2.com`.
